message.content: The corrected c3 probe (t14) completed. Key result: the extrema ±65504 and all subnormals are fine, but there were 50 tolerance violations within the tested |x|≥0.11 band (worst err/tol ratio 1.35). The claim asserts no failure in that band, so the compound assertion is contradicted — I need to characterize where those 50 violations occur before finalizing.

function.arguments:
{"claim_id": "c3", "code": "import torch, json
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("k", "/root/cases/case_139/kernel.py")
k = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(k)
dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

bits = torch.arange(0, 0x7C00, dtype=torch.int32)
vals = bits.to(torch.uint16).view(torch.float16)
big = vals[vals.float() >= 0.11]
sub_bits = torch.arange(1, 256, dtype=torch.int32).to(torch.uint16).view(torch.float16)
extra = torch.tensor([65504.0, -65504.0, 0.0, -0.0, 1.0, -1.0], dtype=torch.float16)
x = torch.cat([big, -big, sub_bits, -sub_bits, extra]).to(dev)
out = k.run(x)
u = x.to(torch.float64); u2 = u*u
ref = u2 / (torch.sqrt(1.0+u2)+1.0)
err = (out.to(torch.float64) - ref).abs()
tol = 1e-8 + 1e-5*ref.abs()
viol = err > tol
v = torch.abs(x.to(torch.float64))[viol]
print(json.dumps({
  "num_violations": int(viol.sum()),
  "violation_abs_x_min": float(v.min()) if int(viol.sum()) else None,
  "violation_abs_x_max": float(v.max()) if int(viol.sum()) else None,
  "largest_x_without_violation_min": float(torch.abs(x.to(torch.float64))[~viol].max()),
  "extrema_65504_ok": bool((err[torch.abs(x.float()) == 65504.0] <= tol[torch.abs(x.float()) == 65504.0]).all().item()),
  "subnormals_all_ok": bool((err[:sub_bits.numel()*2].max() <= 1e-8)),
}))
", "expected_signal": "location of the 50 violations: minimum |x| that violates, confirming whether extrema/subnormals are clean"}
